title: New Infrastructure Bill Passed by Senate in Bipartisan Vote
shortdescription: The US Senate has passed a sweeping infrastructure bill aimed at modernizing nationwide transit, clean water networks, and high-speed regional rail.

description.subtitle: Bipartisan Milestone
description.text: Voting 68-32, lawmakers approved funding for highway repairs, electrical grid updates, and coastal flood defense initiatives.

author.name: David Miller
author.bio: David covers congressional policy and domestic governance.

title: Severe Weather Warnings Issued Across Midwest States
shortdescription: Meteorologists have issued severe thunderstorm and storm surge alerts for multiple states as a powerful cold front collides with humid air.

description.subtitle: Emergency Preparedness Underway
description.text: Governors in Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio have mobilized National Guard units and emergency management crews to respond to potential flash floods.

title: Federal Highway Administration Funding Expansion Approved
shortdescription: State departments of transportation received approval for $45 billion in bridge modernizations and automated traffic safety monitoring systems.

description.subtitle: National Transit Overhaul
description.text: The grants prioritize aging interstate bridges, urban bypass corridors, and EV fast-charging corridors across state borders.

title: National Parks System Reports Record Summer Visitor Numbers
shortdescription: Over 45 million domestic and international tourists visited US national parks during July, prompting expanded shuttle and reservation systems.

description.subtitle: Preserving Wilderness Heritage
description.text: Park Service officials credited improved reservation apps and zero-emission transit shuttles for managing record crowds smoothly.

title: High-Speed Passenger Rail Project Breaks Ground in California
shortdescription: Crews officially began track installation on the electrified express rail link connecting Central Valley communities to coastal transit hubs.

description.subtitle: Next-Gen American Transit
description.text: Engineers anticipate initial testing speeds exceeding 200 mph once electrical catenary power systems are fully energized next year.

title: Coast Guard Completes Major Maritime Safety & Defense Drill
shortdescription: Joint interagency forces completed a comprehensive search-and-rescue and harbor protection exercise off the Atlantic seaboard.

description.subtitle: Port Defense & Maritime Security
description.text: The multi-day exercise simulated severe hurricane responses, container ship escorts, and automated maritime patrol drone integration.
